title: My Unsung Hero: Wendy McDowell's Story

sentences.en: From Hidden Brain Media, I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 这里是隐性大脑传媒，我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is My Unsung Hero.
sentences.zh: 这里是《无名英雄》。

sentences.en: Stories where one person reached out to help another in a time of need.
sentences.zh: 讲述普通人在他人急需时伸出援手的故事。

sentences.en: My story is about a group of unsung heroes.
sentences.zh: 我的故事是关于一群无名英雄的。

sentences.en: He just pulled up a chair and we talked, I'd say, for about 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他拉了把椅子坐下来，我们聊了大概有90分钟吧。

sentences.en: I don't know if she really understands or appreciates the full impact that she's had in my life and still continues to have.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她是否真的理解或感激她对我的生活曾经产生、并且至今仍在产生的深远影响。

sentences.en: Today's story comes from Wendy McDowell.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目来自温迪·麦克道尔。

sentences.en: When Wendy was very young, her parents separated.
sentences.zh: 在温迪很小的时候，她的父母分居了。

sentences.en: A few years later, when she was eight years old, they arranged for her to travel from upstate New York,
sentences.zh: 几年后，当她八岁时，他们安排她从纽约州北部出发——

sentences.en: where she was living with her mom, to North Dakota to visit her dad.
sentences.zh: 她当时和妈妈住在那里——前往北达科他州探望父亲。

sentences.en: No one in Wendy's family was able to fly her back and forth,
sentences.zh: 温迪家里的任何人都没有空陪她飞来飞去，

sentences.en: so it was decided that she would be chaperoned by a family friend, a 19-year-old she had never met.
sentences.zh: 所以大家决定由一位家庭朋友陪同她，那是一个她从未见过的19岁女孩。

sentences.en: We're calling her Kim.
sentences.zh: 我们叫她金好了。

sentences.en: Their flight out to North Dakota was uneventful.
sentences.zh: 他们飞往北达科他州的航班很顺利。

sentences.en: On their way back to the East Coast, Kim and Wendy landed in Chicago for a layover.
sentences.zh: 在返回东海岸的途中，金和温迪在芝加哥转机。

sentences.en: They discovered that their connecting flight was canceled.
sentences.zh: 他们发现接下来的航班被取消了。

sentences.en: And that's when Kim made a choice that Wendy still struggles to understand.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，金做出了一个让温迪至今难以理解的选择。

sentences.en: She booked herself on another flight headed home and left Wendy to fend for herself.
sentences.zh: 她给自己订了另一班回家的飞机，却把温迪留下来自生自灭。

sentences.en: She left me in the Chicago O'Hare Airport as an eight-year-old with no flight, no plan, no adult in charge of me, just literally walked away.
sentences.zh: 她把我一个人留在芝加哥奥黑尔机场，当时我才八岁，没有航班，没有计划，没有成年人管我，她真的就这么走掉了。

sentences.en: I really have no idea how long I cried by myself in the airport.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道自己在机场独自哭了多久。

sentences.en: I remember just feeling so desperate, just that, you know, that feeling that we've all had.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时感到无比绝望，就是那种大家都体验过的感觉。

sentences.en: It's that feeling of being a kid and looking around every single face is a stranger's face.
sentences.zh: 那种作为一个孩子，环顾四周发现每一张脸都是陌生人的感觉。

sentences.en: And just how terrifying that is.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉是多么可怕。

sentences.en: So it was like that, but there was no one coming for me.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这样，但没有人来找我。

sentences.en: I remember this woman walking over to me, and she was wearing white.
sentences.zh: 我记得有个女人朝我走过来，她穿着一身白衣。

sentences.en: I remember she was wearing white.
sentences.zh: 我记得她穿着白色衣服。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think I just remember her being slender and kind of tall and very, very comforting.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我只记得她身材苗条，个子挺高，而且非常、非常让人安心。

sentences.en: Her presence was just immediately comforting, and she made me think of a grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她的存在立刻就给人一种安慰，让我想起了祖母。

sentences.en: And she came, and she sat next to me, and I just remember being immediately feeling a sense of safety because someone was with me.
sentences.zh: 她走过来坐在我旁边，我只记得立刻有了一种安全感，因为有人陪着我了。

sentences.en: And she just really, really gently spoke to me and asked me where I was going and where was my mother.
sentences.zh: 她非常、非常温柔地跟我说话，问我要去哪里，我的母亲在哪里。

sentences.en: And she just very calmly asked my permission to kind of take charge.
sentences.zh: 她非常冷静地征求我的同意，希望能由她来主导这一切。

sentences.en: And she said, if you trust me, I will take care of you.
sentences.zh: 她说，如果你信任我，我就会照顾你。

sentences.en: I have to fly to Pittsburgh, but I will fly to Burlington with you because you can't do this alone.
sentences.zh: 我必须飞往匹兹堡，但我会陪你一起飞往伯灵顿，因为你一个人应付不了这个。

sentences.en: And I'll need you to give your mother's phone number to me so that we can call her.
sentences.zh: 我需要你把母亲的电话号码给我，这样我们就能联系她了。

sentences.en: And I just remember her checking in and saying, do you feel safe?
sentences.zh: 我只记得她一直在确认情况并问我，你觉得安全吗？

sentences.en: Does this feel safe to you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这样安全吗？

sentences.en: And no one had ever checked in with me about my safety, how I felt.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人这样关心过我的安全，关心我的感受。

sentences.en: It was just a really amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 这真是一件非常不可思议的事。

sentences.en: So I did give her my mother's phone number.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实把妈妈的电话号码给了她。

sentences.en: And so she called my mother and told her that she was coming.
sentences.zh: 于是她给我的母亲打了电话，告诉她自己会陪着我。

sentences.en: And my mother said, no, I'm coming there.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈说，不，我要去那儿。

sentences.en: I'm coming there.
sentences.zh: 我要去那儿。

sentences.en: She didn't want me getting on an airplane with a stranger.
sentences.zh: 她不想让我和一个陌生人坐飞机。

sentences.en: And this woman convinced my mother that I would be safe with her.
sentences.zh: 而这位女士说服了我母亲，向她保证我会是安全的。

sentences.en: And I told my mother that I felt safe.
sentences.zh: 我也告诉妈妈我觉得很安全。

sentences.en: And she, indeed, she took care of me.
sentences.zh: 她确实做到了，她照顾了我。

sentences.en: The woman booked her a new ticket, walked her onto the plane, and sat next to her for the two-and-a-half-hour flight home.
sentences.zh: 这位女士为她重新订了机票，把她送上飞机，并在两个半小时的飞行中一直坐在她旁边陪她回家。

sentences.en: Wendy was so focused on getting home that she can't remember where the woman went from there or whether she even got to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 温迪当时一心只想回家，以至于她不记得那个女人后来去了哪里，甚至都不记得有没有跟她道别。

sentences.en: The older I've gotten, the more I've been thinking about her.
sentences.zh: 年纪越大，我对她的思念就越深。

sentences.en: Just knowing that she did all of that for a stranger.
sentences.zh: 只要想到她竟然为素不相识的陌生人做了这一切。

sentences.en: Something that maybe didn't feel huge to her just completely redirected my life because I don't think I have ever been treated as badly as I was by the person who left me.
sentences.zh: 这件事对她来说也许算不上什么大事，但却彻底改变了我的人生轨迹，因为我觉得我从未遭受过像那个抛弃我的人那样恶劣的对待。

sentences.en: And it's a story that I've told my son because I want him to know that people can choose to be beautiful and helpful and provide security and that people like this are out there.
sentences.zh: 我把这个故事讲给我的儿子听，因为我想让他知道，人们可以选择变得美好、乐于助人、带给他人安全感，这样的人在这个世界上是真实存在的。

sentences.en: So I just appreciate it more than words can really express.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此的感激是言语无法真正表达的。

sentences.en: Wendy McDowell lives in Albany, New York.
sentences.zh: 温迪·麦克道尔住在纽约州奥尔巴尼。

sentences.en: In the years after that experience, she was inspired to become a school psychologist, a job she's done now for more than 25 years.
sentences.zh: 在那次经历之后的几年里，她深受启发，成为了一名学校心理学家，这项工作她已经做了二十多年。

sentences.zh: 请不要错过任何这些精彩的故事。

sentences.zh: 我是香卡·韦丹塔姆。
